description: This file defines a Java interface 'SerialPortEventListener' that specifies a contract for handling serial port events within the jSSC library. It contains a single method 'serialEvent' which must be implemented by classes interested in serial port event notifications.

classes.name: SerialPortEventListener
classes.description: Interface for handling serial port events in the jSSC library.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Handles a serial port event. Must be implemented by classes that register as listeners to serial port events.
